name: Button

representativeVariants.whySelected: Default action button for send, confirm in chat interface
representativeVariants.childrenDigest: Label text + optional icon, 40px height, pill radius, brand blue fill

representativeVariants.childrenDigest: Label text, 40px height, pill radius, subtle gray fill

structurePatterns: Pill shape is default for all action buttons (Apple HIG style)
Rounded square for icon-only toolbar buttons
Min width constraint on text buttons to avoid awkward narrow shapes

usageHints.primary: Primary call-to-action: send message, confirm, create
usageHints.secondary: Supporting actions: attach file, add image, format text
usageHints.ghost: Low-emphasis actions: toolbar icons, link-style buttons

keyInsightSeed: Apple-style pill buttons with three sizes, supporting primary/secondary/ghost/destructive variants for chat actions
